title: On derivatives and higher-order derivatives of chromatic polynomials
summary: Let \( G \) be a graph of order \( n \) with maximum degree $Δ$, and let $P(G,x)$ denote its chromatic polynomial. We investigate several properties of $P(G,x)$ related to its derivatives and higher-order derivatives. First, we study the monotonicity of $P(G,x)/x^n$. Dong proved that $(x-1)^nP(G,x)\geq x^nP(G,x-1)$ for all real $x\geq n$. In particular, taking $x=n$ establishes the Bartels-Welsh ``shameful conjecture" that $P(G,n)/P(G,n-1)>e$.
